limits: Capture timestamps are unavailable for all entries, including the nine native baseline frames.
The nine new captures are bound to source revision 00290f2fb45f1b9bc9748b2db973d68aaa1a50c by the private build receipt; public source readback is pending and no current-release claim is made.
1280 by 800 images are native window captures at 96 DPI. 800 by 600 images are renderer emulation and are not native-window or display-scale evidence.
The map frames show no loaded map; they do not prove terrain rendering or selection behavior.
The server frame shows an empty server list; it does not prove server creation or operation.
The configuration frame config-800x600.png is excluded because an overlay obscures the configuration controls.
These baseline images do not prove new-feature completion, a full accessibility or language matrix, current-release behavior, or complete product acceptance.
